text:
Alex: Heads up — we're seeing a perf regression on llama3-13b after the rope_theta default bump. p50 token/sec on chat-template workloads down ~18% in prod.
Mira: repro on dev or only prod?
Alex: Repro on dev; pinned to the same model version. I ran a quick profile on a representative trace.
Alex: ```profiler snippet
before: p50=820 tok/s, kernel=fast_matmul, kv_evictions=12/min
after:  p50=672 tok/s, kernel=fused_attention_slowpath, kv_evictions=85/min, host_spill=+4GB
note: kernel switch at step ~34 of the prompt
```
Jiang: Interesting. head_dim for that variant is 96 (non-multiple of 128/64), could be hitting a non-vectorized codepath in the fused kernel fallback.
Mira: kv_evictions jumped a lot — are we seeing KV cache alignment issues? Maybe stride/packing changed when rope_theta altered token distributions.
Alex: Looks like the kernel selector is choosing fused_attention because the runtime estimates lower latency for current seq profile, but actual microkernel has a slow fallback for head_dim%8!=0.
infra-bot: Deploy 1745009012: rtx-pool autoscale triggered, 3 nodes added -> mitigated tail but not p50.
Sam: Short-term mitigation: can we force model-profile to prefer the unfused_matmul path for that model id? Quick override in model catalog would buy time.
Jiang: Agree. Longer-term: kernel selector needs a sanity check that factors head_dim alignment and quantization path. Prefer aligned kernel unless fused has tested fallbacks.
Emma: Also add a console metric: kernel_choice and host_spill_bytes per model-version. We currently only emit kernel_name for failures.
Mira: I have a small repro harness. If someone adds a model-profile override I can run full sweep across batch sizes and seq lengths.
Alex: Action items:
- Sam: push model-profile override for llama3-13b-1.0 -> prefer unfused_matmul (short term) (owner: Sam)
- Jiang: add selector heuristic to penalize fused kernel if head_dim%8!=0 and quantized path triggers (owner: Jiang)
- Mira: run perf sweep and upload flamegraphs to the thread (owner: Mira)
- Emma: add console metric emit for kernel_choice + host_spill_bytes (owner: Emma)
Sam: I'll push the override now and add a flag in the deploy so it's reversible.
Alex: Thanks. Once Sam's override is live Mira can confirm numbers; if p50 back to pre-bump we'll roll a targeted fix.
Mira: Quick note — saw tiny output logits shift on RMSNorm+SiLU combos in some evals. Not sure related but worth adding to regression checks.
Jiang: Good call. Add an eval set run in the rollout gating to catch RMSNorm/SiLU numeric drift.
Alex: 👍 keeping this thread for status updates. Please ping me if you need extra infra (more dev GPU nodes).
